look: Honduras, Central America. Cinematic travel documentary look, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, natural warm color grade, volumetric light, subtle film grain, ultra detailed, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no logos, no watermarks, nobody smiling at camera.
tomas: B01_carretera
Pre-dawn mountain highway in Honduras winding through pine-covered hills, a single car with headlights driving away into the blue hour mist, distant lights of a town, melancholic and quiet.
B02_familia_carro
Before dawn outside a modest Honduran house with a porch light on: a family of four seen from behind loading bags into the trunk of a car, a sleepy child carrying a pillow, intimate and quiet.
B03_puerta
Close-up of a woman's hand locking the wooden front door of a Honduran house with keys at dawn, a small painted religious image on the wall, soft blue light, quiet goodbye.
B04_celaque
Misty cloud forest in Celaque, Honduras: giant moss-covered trees, ferns and drifting fog lit by shafts of morning sun, mysterious and majestic.
B05_guia
Colonial cobblestone street in Gracias, Lempira at golden hour: a proud local tour guide in his 40s points toward the white colonial church while two visitors, seen from behind, look up, warm light.
B06_cocinera
At dawn in a humble kitchen with a wood-fired comal, a Honduran woman in her 50s skillfully stretches flour tortillas for baleadas, steam and smoke rising in the window light, dignified, focused.
B07_hotelito
Morning in La Ceiba: the owner of a small colorful beach hotel opens the wooden shutters and front doors, palm trees and the sea behind, sunlight flooding in, hopeful.
B08_limpieza
Sunrise on a Caribbean beach in Trujillo, Honduras: a group of young volunteers in t-shirts picking up trash with bags and gloves along the shoreline, golden light, community spirit, seen in motion.
B09_mercado
Busy colorful market street in Comayagua with the colonial cathedral in the background, vendors with fruit and textiles, shoppers walking, warm afternoon light, lively.
B10_morazan
Sunset in central Tegucigalpa: the bronze equestrian statue of Francisco Morazán in silhouette against a dramatic orange and purple sky, the city hills behind with lights turning on, epic and solemn.
B11_nino
Close-up of a Honduran boy around 8 years old looking out of a car window at passing green mountains, soft sunlight on his face, reflections on the glass, thoughtful and hopeful.
B12_abuela
An elderly Honduran grandmother standing in the doorway of her adobe house with a red tile roof, hand resting on the door frame, looking out toward the road at sunset, warm light, nostalgic.
B13_llegada
Golden sunset on a beautiful Honduran Caribbean beach: a family seen from behind arriving on the sand, two children running toward the turquoise sea, the parents holding hands, joyful and peaceful.
B14_pescadores
Dawn on the bay of Trujillo, Honduras: Garifuna fishermen pushing a wooden boat into calm golden water, mountains behind, mist, timeless.
